readmeMarkdown:
# Pick Me.

An Antigravity plugin for job application assistance that compiles ATS-compliant Typst resumes, writes targeted cover letters, crawls job postings, prepares STAR interview answers, and tracks application pipelines in CSV.

All generated documents are compiled to PDF and stored in `~/Documents/pick-me-output/` for clean organization.

## Architecture

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`job-posting-crawler`** | Subagent | Discovers and live-verifies job postings across ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) and job portals with a 3-day freshness filter and a 100-point experience-first rubric. |
| **`resume-builder`** | Inline Skill | Tailors single-column Typst resumes to job descriptions. Enforces entity boundaries between past roles, requires a pre-generation plan approval, and compiles to PDF. |
| **`cover-letter-builder`** | Inline Skill | Drafts 3-paragraph (140–220 words) cover letters grounded in verified profile facts. Decouples unrelated technical domains with clean narrative transitions. |
| **`interview-helper`** | Inline Skill | Mines candidate stories from profile data into STAR talking points and conducts single-question mock interview simulations. |
| **`application-tracker`** | Inline Skill | Manages application lifecycles and follow-up schedules in RFC 4180 CSV (`data/applications.csv`). |
| **`well-being-coach`** | Inline Skill | Guides sustainable pacing (2–3 tailored applications per day) and de-personalizes automated rejections. |
| **`get-to-know-me`** | Inline Skill | Onboards candidates via existing resume import or a 4-phase conversational interview to populate profile facts and STAR stories. |


## Prerequisites

- [Google Antigravity](https://github.com/google-deepmind)
- PowerShell 7+ or Windows PowerShell
- [Typst CLI](https://typst.app/):
  ```powershell
  winget install --id Typst.Typst
  ```

## Installation

Install via the Antigravity CLI:

```powershell
agy plugin install https://github.com/auxghlann/pick-me
```

Or install from a local clone:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/auxghlann/pick-me.git
cd pick-me
agy plugin install .
```

## Quickstart

### 1. Initialize Candidate Profile
Create candidate data files from templates:

```powershell
.\scripts\init-profile.ps1
```

This creates:
- `data/candidate-profile.yaml`: Master work history, skills, target preferences, and explicit `domain` / `scope_boundary` attributes.
- `data/star-stories.md`: Behavioral interview anecdotes structured into Situation, Task, Action, and Result.
- `data/applications.csv`: RFC 4180 pipeline tracker.

Alternatively, run `/get-to-know-me` in Antigravity to import an existing resume (`.pdf`, `.md`, `.txt`) or complete guided onboarding.

### 2. Tailor a Resume
Prompt Antigravity with a target job description:

```text
Tailor my resume for this role: [paste JD]
```

`resume-builder` will draft a plan artifact with inline source attribution tags (`[Source: ... | Domain: ...]`), request your approval, and compile the resume via `scripts/compile.ps1` to `~/Documents/pick-me-output/applications/<app_id>_<company>/resume_<company>.pdf`.

### 3. Draft a Cover Letter
Prompt Antigravity:

```text
Draft a cover letter for this job: [paste JD]
```

`cover-letter-builder` drafts a 3-paragraph letter (140–220 words) with an entity attribution audit, awaits approval, and compiles via `scripts/compile.ps1` to `~/Documents/pick-me-output/applications/<app_id>_<company>/cover_letter_<company>.pdf`.

### 4. Edit Visually in Pick Me Studio (Zero Tokens)
To make quick wording or layout edits to any generated resume or cover letter without spending LLM tokens, launch the local split-screen editor:

```powershell
.\scripts\studio.ps1
```

This opens `http://127.0.0.1:8765/` in your browser where you can select any `.typ` file from `~/Documents/pick-me-output/`, upload a `.typ` file from disk, dynamically add or remove sections in the **Visual Form** (or switch to **Raw `.typ`**), and press `Ctrl+S` to recompile and export the PDF via Typst.

### 5. Search & Verify Opportunities
Launch the crawler subagent:

```text
Find active Junior Data Engineer jobs in Manila or Remote posted in the last 3 days
```

`job-posting-crawler` verifies URL accessibility and score-ranks matching postings.

### 6. Track Applications
Update or inspect application records:

```text
Update APP-003 status to Screening
```

`application-tracker` computes weekly velocity and alerts when follow-up dates (+7 to +14 days) arrive.

## Data Privacy & Output Layout

All candidate files in `data/` (`candidate-profile.yaml`, `star-stories.md`, `applications.csv`) are git-ignored. Generated outputs are written to your local documents directory:

```text
~/Documents/pick-me-output/
├── applications/
│   └── <app_id>_<company>/
│       ├── resume_<company>.typ
│       ├── resume_<company>.pdf
│       ├── cover_letter_<company>.typ
│       └── cover_letter_<company>.pdf
└── crawls/
    └── crawl_<timestamp>.pdf
```

## Pick Me v1.4.0: Studio Deduplication, Security Hardening & Unified Package Protocol

### Security & Hardening
- **Path Traversal Guards (scripts/studio.ps1)**: Added Test-AllowedStudioPath restricting file loading and PDF serving strictly to allowed output directories (~/Documents/pick-me-output/), scratch directories, and read-only template folders.
- **Origin Header Validation**: Enforced strict loopback Origin checks (127.0.0.1 and localhost) to block cross-origin requests from arbitrary browser contexts.
- **DOM XSS Elimination (	emplates/studio/editor.js)**: Replaced unsafe innerHTML interpolation of user-supplied section titles and card headers with safe DOM text node assignment (.textContent).

### Added & Enhanced
- **Visual Section Reordering**: Added Move Up and Move Down controls in section headers with boundary checks to reorder resume sections visually.
- **Page Count Status Indicator**: Displayed compiled PDF page count directly in the Studio status bar upon file load and compilation.
- **Unified Application Package Protocol**: Codified unified package protocol in 
esume-builder and cover-letter-builder to share sequential application IDs and review plans across combined requests.
- **Automatic Output Relocation Guard (scripts/compile.ps1)**: Automatically relocates repository-staged .typ files to ~/Documents/pick-me-output/applications/<AppFolder>/ before compiling.

### Bug Fixes
- **Resume Macro Rendering Drift**: Upgraded truncated #let exp-entry and #let project-entry macro bodies in 
ormalizeStylePreamble so company location and project dates render visibly in compiled PDFs.
- **Typst Array Spread Syntax**: Emitted trailing commas for single-bullet tuples ([bullet],) so Typst ..bullets spread syntax compiles cleanly.

### Refactored & Removed
- **Frontend Modularization & Deduplication**: Extracted pure AST parsing into 	emplates/studio/parser.js and visual DOM generation into 	emplates/studio/editor.js, reducing repetitive card building by 176 lines via createEntityCard.
- **Typst PDF Skill Consolidation**: Removed redundant skills/typst-pdf/ wrapper skill and dead scripts/compile-typst.ps1 script in favor of top-level scripts/compile.ps1 and 
ules/AGENTS.md.
- **Subagent Tool Alignment**: Added 
ead_file, write_file, and edit_file to gents/job-posting-crawler.md tools manifest.
